Bill.BriefDescription: Relating to electronic monitoring of sex offenders.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to electronic monitoring of sex offenders; addinga new section to chapter 72.09 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) County sheriffs shall select sex offenders within their countyto be electronically monitored with passive global positioning systemtechnology. Selection of which offenders to monitor shall be at thejudgment of the sheriff, but in making the determinations, the sheriffshall consider: (a) An offender's risk assessment from the department ofcorrections; (b) An offender's risk level classification and likelihood ofreoffense; (c) Whether an offender is under community supervision; (d) Whether an offender is registered as homeless; and (e) Whether an offender committed a sex offense against a minor. (2) Funds shall be distributed to counties based on the percentage p. 1 SB 6322of total registered sex offenders in Washington state that reside ineach county.
If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided byJune 30, 2006, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null andvoid.
